DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と連絡を取りながら、集合場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your meeting point while keeping in touch with the people you're with?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が先に着いたそうですが、入口の写真が私のいる所と違います。中へ入る前に合流したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族と入口写真が違い入場前合流を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family says they've already arrived, but their photo of the entrance looks different from where I am. I'd like to meet up before going in.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your entrance photo differs from your family's and you want to meet before entering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口という言葉だけでは行き違うかもしれません。お互いに近くの案内板の名称を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Just saying entrance might lead you to different places. Please both check the names on nearby information signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の所には入口案内所とあります。家族は駐車場の案内板を見ているそうです。暗い通路で探し合うのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両者の案内板名と暗所探索を避けたい事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine says Entrance Information Center. My family says they're looking at a parking lot sign. I'd rather not search for each other in dark passageways.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the names on both parties' signs and explain why you want to avoid searching in the dark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、案内所の明るい正面を集合場所として伝えてはいかがですか。家族が見つけられるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then how about telling them to meet at the brightly lit front of the information center? Let's check whether they can find it.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内所の正面で青い傘を持って待つと伝えました。家族もこちらへ来ると返事をくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明るい案内所正面と青い傘を集合目印にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've told them I'll wait in front of the information center holding a blue umbrella. They've replied that they're coming here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the brightly lit front of the information center and a blue umbrella as the meeting landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お客様は動かずお待ちください。入場の列とは別に、通路を空けた位置でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please stay where you are and wait. Keep separate from the admission queue, in a position that leaves the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列の横の広い所で待ちます。入場券は家族が持っているので、一人で中へは進みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路確保と券を持つ家族待ちを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait in the wide space beside the queue. My family has the admission tickets, so I won't go inside alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you'll leave the passage clear and wait for your family, who have the tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それならここで合流してから入場の確認をしてください。返事が途切れたら、現在地を変えずにご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then meet up here before checking admission. If their replies stop coming, stay where you are and ask us for help.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に着いた私が動かない約束にしました。家族が見えたら声をかけ、揃ってから入口へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先着者固定と全員合流後入場を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've agreed that I, as the one who got here first, won't move. I'll call out when I see my family, and we'll head to the entrance once everyone is together.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide that the first arrival stays put and everyone enters only after meeting up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合流の目印が決まってよかったです。足元にお気をつけてお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you've settled on a meeting landmark. Please watch your step while you wait. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 折り畳みのカートを二種類比べていらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're comparing two types of folding cart, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩いて買い物に行くので欲しいのですが、玄関が狭いです。使うときより、しまうときの大きさを重視しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩買物と収納幅の優先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like one because I walk to do my shopping, but my entrance hall is narrow. The size when stored matters more to me than the size when in use.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you shop on foot and prioritize storage width. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本は畳んだ状態をご覧いただけます。収納する場所の幅は測ってありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can see this sample in its folded state. Have you measured the width of the storage space?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。予算は五千円ですが、安い方でも玄関に置けなければ困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未測定の玄関と予算五千円を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My budget is five thousand yen, but even the cheaper one would be a problem if it won't fit in my entrance hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't measured your entrance hall and your budget is five thousand yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 価格はこちらの札です。畳んだときの幅を、商品表示で一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price is on this tag. Let's check its folded width together on the product label.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この幅をメモします。車輪も外す必要があるタイプか、見本を動かして確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 収納幅メモと車輪着脱の実演を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note down this width. Could we move the sample to check whether this type also needs its wheels removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the storage width and ask for a demonstration of whether the wheels need removing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店員が展示用の見本でご説明します。こちらは車輪を付けたまま畳む設計です。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will demonstrate using the display sample. This one is designed to fold with the wheels still attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取り外しが毎回必要でないのは助かります。ただ、重い荷物を入れた状態の持ち上げやすさも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車輪設計と荷物入りの持上げやすさを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's helpful not to have to remove them every time. But I'm also wondering how easy it is to lift with heavy shopping inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the wheel design and ease of lifting it with shopping inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持てる重さは個人差があります。表示の耐荷重もご確認ください。見本の軽さだけで判断しないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: How much someone can lift varies from person to person. Please check the stated load capacity too. It's best not to judge just by how light the sample feels.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は寸法と耐荷重をメモして帰ります。玄関を測り、普段の荷物の重さも確認してから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法と耐荷重を確認して購入を延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll note the dimensions and load capacity and go home. I'll buy after measuring my entrance hall and checking the weight of my usual shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the dimensions and load capacity and postpone your purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 比較のメモをお持ちください。収納場所に合う物をお選びくださいね。ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your comparison notes with you. Choose something that fits your storage space. Thank you, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の説明について、ご利用になりたいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to use to learn about the exhibits?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 細かい文字が読みにくいので、音声で説明を聞ける展示を探しています。入口で借りる機械はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 細字の読みにくさと音声説明機器を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Small print is difficult to read, so I'm looking for exhibits with audio explanations. Is there a device I can borrow at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that small print is hard to read and ask about audio explanation devices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日の架空の展示では、専用の貸出機はありません。一部の説明は、ご自身の端末で案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: In today's fictional exhibition, there are no dedicated devices to borrow. For some explanations, you can check the guidance on your own device.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の電話を使います。イヤホンがないので、小さい音ならそのまま流してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端末使用とイヤホンなしの音出し可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll use my phone. I don't have earphones, so may I play it quietly through the speaker?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll use your own device and ask whether sound may be played without earphones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲の鑑賞の妨げになる場合があります。音を出さずに読める説明か、職員の説明をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: That may disturb other visitors. Please use explanations you can read silently or ask a staff member to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、音声を流さず、まず概要の説明をお願いします。この道具は使い方を見る展示でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音を出さず概要と道具展示の趣旨を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll keep the audio off and ask for an overview first. Is this an exhibit where we see how this tool is used?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the sound off and ask for an overview and the purpose of the tool exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具の用途を紹介する展示です。展示品を動かさず、横の図をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: This exhibit introduces the tool's purpose. Please look at the diagram beside it without moving the object.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 触らず図を見ます。説明を覚えるために、図だけ写真に撮ってよいかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示品に触れず図の撮影可否を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the diagram without touching it. I'd also like to know whether I can photograph just the diagram to remember the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't touch the exhibit and ask whether the diagram may be photographed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この区画の撮影表示を確認してください。撮影禁止の図や展示もあるので、すべて同じ扱いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the photography signs in this section. Some diagrams and exhibits cannot be photographed, so the same rule doesn't apply to everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 禁止なら写真を撮らず、自分のメモに要点だけ書きます。次はイヤホンを持って来て、音声の案内も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 禁止時のメモと次回イヤホン持参を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: If it's prohibited, I won't take a photo; I'll just write the main points in my own notes. Next time I'll bring earphones and check the audio guide too.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take notes if photos are prohibited and bring earphones next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ表示に沿ってご覧ください。お困りの際はお声がけくださいね。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the signs as you look around. If you need help, do ask us. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符のご購入について、片道か往復かお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided whether to buy a one-way or return ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りの日がまだ決まりません。往復で買えばいつでも戻れると思っていましたが、条件がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰日未定と往復券の条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't decided my return date. I thought buying a return ticket meant I could come back any time. Are there conditions?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your return date is undecided and ask about return ticket conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切符の種類によって条件が違います。行き先と、いま決まっている出発日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The conditions depend on the ticket type. Please tell me your destination and the departure date you've already decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行き先は小倉で、出発は明日です。帰りは仕事の予定が出てから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小倉行きと明日出発を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm going to Kokura and leaving tomorrow. I'd like to decide the return after my work schedule is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you're going to Kokura and departing tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、明日の行きの選択肢から確認しましょう。帰りの日を未定のまま、どの券でも使えるとは案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's start by checking the outward options for tomorrow. I can't tell you that any ticket can be used with the return date left undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行きだけ先に買う案にします。時刻もまだ迷っているので、列車を指定するかどうかの違いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片道先行と列車指定有無の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll plan to buy just the outward ticket first. I'm still unsure of the time, so I'd like to hear the difference between tickets that specify a train and those that don't.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Plan to buy the outward ticket first and ask about specifying a train versus not specifying one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用したい列車に応じて、購入窓口で条件と料金を比較してください。こちらの案内票に相談内容を記しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Compare the conditions and fares at the sales counter according to the train you'd like to use. I'll write your questions on this information slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 指定の有無だけでなく、変更や払い戻しの条件も購入前に確かめます。券売機で難しければ窓口で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入前の変更返金条件と窓口相談を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before buying, I'll check the conditions for changes and refunds as well as whether a train is specified. If it's difficult at the machine, can I ask at the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check change and refund conditions before buying and ask about counter assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窓口でご相談ください。空席や取扱はその時点で確認しますので、ここで希望の便を確保したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the counter. Availability and handling will be checked at that time; this hasn't secured your preferred service here.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の小倉行き片道を相談し、列車と変更条件を確認してから買います。帰りは日程が決まってから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道の列車条件確認後購入し帰路を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about a one-way ticket to Kokura tomorrow and buy after checking the train and change conditions. I'll consider the return once the dates are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy the one-way ticket after checking train conditions and hold off on the return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談内容のメモを持って窓口へどうぞ。良いご旅行になりますように。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your note of the questions to the counter. I hope you have a good trip. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コースの前に、食べられない材料について確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the set course, shall we check which ingredients you can't eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大豆アレルギーがあります。魚そのものだけでなく、たれや付け合わせの原材料も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大豆アレルギーと調味料付合せの確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a soy allergy. I'd like to know the ingredients in the sauces and side dishes as well as the fish itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your soy allergy and ask to check seasonings and accompaniments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ポン酢やしょうゆを使う料理があります。厨房と表示で確認しますが、共用の器具からの混入を完全には保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some dishes use ponzu or soy sauce. We'll check with the kitchen and the labels, but we can't fully guarantee against cross-contact from shared utensils.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ポン酢を別添えにしても、最初から料理に使っていたら避けられないですね。下味も確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別添えだけでなく下味の大豆を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even if the ponzu is served separately, I couldn't avoid it if it's already been used in cooking. Could you check the initial seasoning too?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about soy in the initial seasoning, rather than only having sauce served separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。下味と仕上げを分けて確認します。どの程度の接触で症状が出るかは、こちらでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll check the initial seasoning and finishing separately. We can't judge what degree of contact would trigger your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前少量で症状が出たので、確実に避けられないなら料理は注文しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量反応と無保証時の食事断念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've had symptoms from a small amount before, so if it can't definitely be avoided, I won't order food.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you've reacted to a small amount and won't eat if avoidance can't be guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。無理に召し上がらないでください。同行者のお食事とは分けて、ご本人が選ぶものを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please don't force yourself to eat. Let's check your own choices separately from your companion's meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者はコースを食べます。私は食べず、表示を確認できる密封の水だけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と食事を分け密封水を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion will have the set course. I won't eat; I'd like only sealed water whose label I can check.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your meal from your companion's and request sealed water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 密封の水の表示はこちらです。食品以外のご希望も含め、ご自身で確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the label for the sealed water. Including requests for things other than food, please check for yourself before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。私はこの水だけにします。料理は同行者が自分で注文しますので、私の分は含めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を確認し本人の料理分を除外する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked it. I'll just have this water. My companion will order their own food, so please don't include a portion for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the label and ask to exclude food for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人分は水のみと承りました。確認へのご協力ありがとうございます。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted water only for you. Thank you for helping us check. I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は仮設通路の周りを整理します。海側の柵の外へは出ないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll tidy around the temporary walkway. Don't go outside the fence on the sea side.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通路内の片付けが担当ですね。軽い板が風で動いていますが、先に倉庫へ運んだほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 担当範囲と風で動く板の運搬可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm responsible for tidying inside the walkway, right? A light board is moving in the wind. Should I carry it to the storehouse first?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check your assigned area and whether you may carry the board moving in the wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一人で運ぶのはやめてください。風の状況と運搬方法を確認するので、その板にはまだ触らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't carry it alone. I'll check the wind conditions and transport method, so don't touch that board yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触らず、歩行者が近づかないように報告します。板の横で立って見張るのも危ないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 板に触らず報告し監視位置の危険を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave it untouched and report it so pedestrians don't approach. Would standing beside the board to watch it be dangerous too?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report without touching the board and ask about danger at the position where you'd watch it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飛んでくるおそれのある位置には立たないでください。こちらの退避位置から、場所を無線で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't stand where it could fly toward you. Report its location by radio from this safe retreat point.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 退避位置へ移ります。板は通路の海側の端に二枚あります。柵の外に落ちても追って取りに行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退避と二枚の位置を伝え柵外回収をしないと約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move to the retreat point. There are two boards at the sea-side edge of the walkway. Even if they fall outside the fence, I won't go after them.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you'll retreat, give the location of the two boards, and promise not to retrieve them outside the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その通りです。回収は担当を決めます。現在できる作業は、風で動かない箱の中のごみを整理することだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. We'll assign someone to retrieve them. The only task you can do now is sort the rubbish in the box that isn't moving in the wind.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱の整理だけにします。袋を置く場所も風で飛ばない囲いの中でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱整理のみと囲いの保管場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll just sort the box. Is it also all right to put the bags inside the enclosure where they won't blow away?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll only sort the box and ask about storing bags in the enclosure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの囲いに入れてください。運搬を再開するときは私が直接指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, put them in this enclosure. I'll give you direct instructions when transport can resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 退避位置から板の場所を知らせ、許可された箱の整理だけ進めます。板の運搬は指示が出るまで始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 報告と限定作業と指示待ちの順序を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report the boards' location from the retreat point and only continue the permitted box sorting. I won't start moving the boards until instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the sequence of reporting, doing only the limited task, and waiting for instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当範囲を守ってお願いします。私は状況確認へ向かいます。変化があれば無線で呼んでください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within your assigned duties. I'm going to check the situation. Call me by radio if anything changes. I'll be off.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの情報を確認されたいのですね。請求書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check the transfer details, correct? Do you have the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。契約した会社の名前と、振込先の口座名義が違うので、送ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求会社と口座名義の不一致を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. The name of the company I contracted with differs from the recipient account holder's name, so I'm unsure whether I should send the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the mismatch between the billing company's name and the account holder's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで契約上の正当な支払先を判断することはできません。まず請求元へ名義の理由を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't determine the legitimate payee under your contract here. First, ask the issuer of the invoice why that account name is used.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 請求書に新しい電話番号が書かれていますが、それだけを使わず、契約時に確認した連絡先へ問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既知の契約連絡先へ名義照会する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a new phone number on the invoice, but I won't rely only on that. I'll contact them using the details I checked when signing the contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your plan to ask about the account name using the known contract contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうして確認結果を整理してください。振込手数料も、利用方法や条件に応じて案内を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do that and organize the results of your checks. You'll also need to check transfer fee information according to the method and conditions of use.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名義が確認できるまで今日は送りません。窓口と別の方法で費用が違うか、説明だけ聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込保留と方法別費用比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't send it today until the account name is verified. Could I just hear whether the cost differs between using the counter and another method?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off on the transfer and ask for a cost comparison by method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料金の案内で比較できます。送金先の銀行や金額など、必要な条件を確認してからご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can compare them using the fee information. I'll explain after checking the necessary details, such as the recipient bank and the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求額は三万円です。口座番号を入力して名前が出ても、契約の相手と同じ会社だと確定したことにはならないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額三万円と名義表示の限界を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: The invoice is for thirty thousand yen. Even if entering the account number brings up a name, that doesn't establish that it's the same company I contracted with, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the thirty-thousand-yen amount and confirm the limits of seeing an account name displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。表示された名義の照合と、請求の正当性の確認は別です。不明なまま確定操作をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Matching the displayed account name and checking the invoice's legitimacy are separate matters. Don't confirm the transfer while it's unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず契約時の連絡先へ確認します。支払先と金額と費用を全部確かめてから、振込方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払先金額費用の確認後に方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll check using the contact details from when I signed the contract. I'll decide how to transfer after checking the payee, amount and fees in full.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the method after checking the payee, amount and fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は説明のみとして承りました。請求書をお忘れなく。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that today is for information only. Don't forget your invoice. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の操作でお困りでしょうか。どの表示まで進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ticket machine? Which screen have you reached?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行き先を選びましたが、使う日を選ぶ画面が出ません。明日の朝に使う切符を今買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明朝に使う切符を今買いたいが日付の選択画面が出ないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've selected the destination, but no screen for choosing the travel date appears. I want to buy a ticket now to use tomorrow morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to buy a ticket now for tomorrow morning, but no date selection screen appears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ支払いはされていませんね。画面の操作を止めて、ご希望の列車を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't paid yet, correct? Stop using the screen and let's check the train you'd like.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いはしていません。明日の午前七時台に出発する予定で、列車はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払いはまだで明日の七時台を予定しているが列車は未定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't paid. I plan to leave sometime between seven and eight tomorrow morning, but haven't chosen a train yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't paid and plan to depart in the seven o'clock hour tomorrow, but haven't chosen a train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行き先と、片道か往復かを教えてください。日付を含め、窓口で扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me your destination and whether it's one-way or return. We'll check the arrangements, including the date, at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先は高松で、片道です。今の画面から間違えて今日の切符を買うのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 高松まで片道で今日の切符を誤購入するのが心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm going one-way to Takamatsu. I'm worried I might accidentally buy a ticket for today from this screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a one-way ticket to Takamatsu and fear buying today's ticket by mistake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは、この画面はいったん取り消しましょう。取り消しの表示が出たら、購入前の画面に戻ったことを確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's cancel this screen for now. When the cancellation message appears, check that you've returned to the screen before purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取り消せました。明日の切符については、隣の窓口で相談すればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作を取り消せたと伝え隣の窓口で翌日の切符を相談してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've managed to cancel it. Should I ask at the counter next door about tomorrow's ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you canceled the operation and ask whether you may consult the counter next door about tomorrow's ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。明朝に使う片道の切符とお伝えください。時間が未定であることも、係員に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Say you want a one-way ticket to use tomorrow morning. Also tell the staff that the time isn't settled.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の七時台に乗りたいことも伝えます。券売機では買わず、窓口で日付を確かめてから購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 七時台の希望を窓口に伝え日付確認後に購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll also say I'd like to travel between seven and eight tomorrow morning. I won't buy at the machine; I'll check the date at the counter before purchasing.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll tell the counter your preference for the seven o'clock hour and buy after checking the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 購入する前に日付をご確認ください。明日のご旅行が順調に進みますように。それでは、行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the date before buying. I hope tomorrow's trip goes smoothly. Have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 処置後の説明について、確認したい点は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you still want to check about the explanation after your procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 早くて聞き取れなかった部分があります。帰ってから何を避けるのか、紙でいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 処置後に避けることを聞き取れず紙の説明を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Some parts were too fast for me to catch. Could I have written instructions about what to avoid after going home?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you couldn't catch what to avoid after the procedure and want a written explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お渡しできる説明書を確認します。特に分からなかったのは、どの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check which instruction sheet we can give you. Which part was particularly unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入浴についてです。今日はシャワーも控えるという意味だったのか、分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日のシャワーも控える意味だったか分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was about bathing. I didn't understand whether it meant avoiding even a shower today.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you weren't sure whether it meant avoiding even a shower that day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 処置の内容に合わせて指示を確認しますね。ご自分で判断せず、担当者に確かめてからお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the instructions for your particular procedure. Rather than you deciding for yourself, I'll ask the person in charge and then tell you.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家では日本語の説明を読むのに時間がかかるので、大事な所に印を付けていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日本語を読むのに時間がかかるため大事な箇所に印を付けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. It takes me time to read Japanese at home, so I'd like you to mark the important sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have important sections marked because reading Japanese takes you time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明書が用意できたら、担当者と確認した注意点に印を付けます。連絡が必要な場合の相談先も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the instruction sheet is ready, I'll mark the precautions checked with the person in charge. Let's also check whom to ask if you need to get in touch.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 病院が閉まっている時間に困った場合は、どこへ連絡するかも書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病院が閉まっている時の連絡先も書面に記載してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you also write down whom to contact if I have trouble while the hospital is closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for written contact details for when the hospital is closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる連絡先と時間帯を確認して記入します。症状に関する判断は担当者から説明しますので、もう少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check and fill in the available contacts and their hours. The person in charge will explain the assessment of symptoms, so please wait a little longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、入浴の指示と連絡先を確認してから帰ります。理解できたか、自分の言葉で言い直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入浴指示と連絡先の確認後に帰り説明を自分の言葉で言い直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll check the bathing instructions and contact details before going home. May I repeat the explanation in my own words to see whether I've understood?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll go home after checking bathing instructions and contacts, and want to repeat the explanation in your own words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ぜひ言い直してみてください。説明を確かめてからご案内します。それでは、お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do try repeating it. We'll guide you after checking the explanation. Take care, and I hope you recover well.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲料の箱売りをご希望ですか。お持ちの一本と同じ商品をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like drinks by the box? Are you looking for the same product as the bottle you're holding?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で配る飲み物を十二本買いたいです。この小さいボトルを箱で買えればと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい飲料を職場用に十二本買いたく箱売りを希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy twelve drinks to hand out at work. I was hoping to buy these small bottles by the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want twelve small drinks for work and would like to buy them by the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの箱は一本五百ミリリットルです。お持ちのものは三百五十ミリリットルですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bottles in this box are five hundred milliliters each. The one you're holding is three hundred and fifty milliliters.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当に違いますね。机が狭いので、三百五十ミリリットルの方を十二本そろえたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 机が狭いため三百五十ミリリットルを十二本そろえたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They really are different. The desks are small, so I'd like twelve of the three-hundred-and-fifty-milliliter bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want twelve three-hundred-and-fifty-milliliter bottles because desk space is limited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さい方は棚にある分からお選びいただけます。まず同じ味の在庫を数えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can choose the smaller ones from the stock on the shelf. I'll first count how many of the same flavor we have.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚には九本しか見えません。残り三本がなければ、味を変えても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 棚は九本に見え残り三本がなければ別の味でもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can only see nine on the shelf. If you don't have the other three, a different flavor is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you see nine on the shelf and another flavor is fine if the remaining three aren't available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この味は今、九本です。別の味なら三本ありますが、配る方の希望は大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have nine of this flavor now. There are three of another flavor, but will that suit the people you're giving them to?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲む人に選んでもらう予定なので、二種類で大丈夫です。九本と三本を混ぜて持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲む人が選べるため九本と別の味三本の二種類を買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to let people choose, so two flavors are fine. I'll take a mix of nine and three.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll buy nine plus three of another flavor, making two flavors so people can choose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。箱にまとまっていないため、持ち運び用の袋をご用意になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Since they aren't together in a box, will you provide a bag to carry them?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 丈夫な袋を持っています。十二本を数えて入れますので、レジでは一本ずつ読み取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 丈夫な袋に十二本を入れレジで一本ずつ読み取ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a sturdy bag. I'll count and put in the twelve bottles, so please scan them one at a time at the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll put twelve bottles in a sturdy bag and ask for each to be scanned at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、九本と三本をこちらへお持ちします。重くなりますので、帰り道は気をつけてお運びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll bring the nine and three over here. They'll be heavy, so please carry them carefully on your way back.
